title: Guidelines on Access to Biological Resources and Associated Knowledge and Benefits Sharing Regulations
description: Official notification outlining access fee structure, benefit-sharing percentages (0.1% to 5%), and application procedures (Form I to IV).

title: Guidance on IPR Applications involving Biological Resources (Section 6 NBA)

title: People's Biodiversity Register (PBR) Guidelines (NBA)
description: Guidelines for documentation of local biological resources and associated traditional knowledge by Biodiversity Management Committees (BMCs).
